sources.title: Pink Face [GERMANIUM] - Bad Pixel Pedals
sources.h1: Bad Pixel Pedals — Germanium Pink Face Fuzz
sources.excerpt:
Pink Face [GERMANIUM] - Bad Pixel Pedals Fuzz Overdrive Boost CLASSIC SERIES Custom Videos artwork About Barbie called. She wants her pedal back..... If color can describe sensation and feelings there is a good analogy in this pedal. It is smooth like powder. It is silky, and pink..... -Accurate F. FACE PCB -all USSR high quality, military specs [most] capacitors -all 1/2 watt carbon comp resistors -Russian [nos]  GT402 and Mp20 Germanium transistors -alpha pots -neutrik jacks -1590P1 HAMMOND ALUMINUM ENCLOSURE 6.024"x3.268" (153mm x 83mm) _deep etch _buffed to a shine -Highest quality -Hand built in Greece -positive ground pedal. Negative tip. You can power it up with any standard [boss type negative tip adapter]. Do not daisy chain with negative ground pedals. Or use a battery. Fuzzes love non alkaline batteries and perform their best with them. You can select a combination of GT402 for Q1 and Mp20 for Q2 or Two Mp20 [Q1&Q2]. The first set gives you a bit more edge and gain, but still it breaks really nice and it cleans great. The next combination is a bit lower gain and it has a very nice quality to the clean sound [very woody]. So you can compensate for higher or lower gain amps. If you feel your amp puts too much gain and your fuzz sounds squashed you just use your selector toggle and dial in a more usable tone. I cannot say enough good things about those NOS USSR tranies. They cannot sound bad....... that's all. So open and creamy it will melt your guitar in your hands. You just got to try one and forget all other things. All the fuzz and clean sounds you will ever need with a roll of your volume pot. You will never again have to tap dance to switch on and off a bunch of pedals to reach for those legendary fuzz tones. One pedal on all the time!!!! I am a minimalist by nature: guitar - Pink face - cranked amp.................you know it's true old version Powered by Create your own unique website with customizable templates. Get Started

- **Builder:** Bad Pixel Pedals
- **Catalog type:** Fuzz
- **Identity:** Germanium Fuzz Face-style fuzz with external Bias and a transistor selector choosing between GT402 + MP20 or a dual-MP20 configuration. [1][2]

- **Fuzz**
- **Volume**
- **External Bias**
- **Transistor selector**
- True bypass.
- Positive-ground circuit. [1]

- **Technology:** Germanium.
- **Documented choices:** Russian NOS **GT402 + MP20**, or **2 × MP20**. [1]
- The exact gain/leakage characteristics of each selected device are not published.

- Exact clipping/protection diode arrangement is not publicly documented.

- Accurate Fuzz Face PCB.
- NOS Soviet components.
- Alpha pots.
- Neutrik jacks.
- Hammond **1590P1** enclosure.
- Deep-etched silver aluminum chassis.
- Handmade in Greece. [1]

- **9V battery**.
- Standard negative-tip adapter support.
- Positive ground means ordinary mixed-pedal daisy chaining is not recommended. [1]

- The builder links an older version, but exact electronic changes between versions are not established.
- Transistor selector configuration is a functional build option rather than a numbered revision.

The transistor selector is intended to change gain and response, while external Bias expands the available operating range. Bad Pixel emphasizes dynamic cleanup from the guitar volume. [1][2]
